items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: And after that I found Artie Shaw’s record

ctx.x: And after that I found Artie Shaw’s record, and then after that Buddy DeFranco records, and they were so different. A different experience of music. And then I copied a Buddy DeFranco phrase, maybe five albums I copied all his improvisation.
